verses.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all di saints for Christ Jesus wey dey Philippi, with di overseers and di deacons:
Grace to una and peace from God our Papa and di Lord Jesus Christ.
I dey thank my God every time wey I remember una,
always for every prayer wey I dey pray for una all, as I dey pray am with joy,
because una join hand with me for di work of di Good News from di first day until now;
I dey sure of this very thing, say di one wey start good work for una go complete am until di day of Jesus Christ.
E dey right for me to think like this about una all, because I carry una for my heart, because both for my chains and for di defense and confirmation of di Good News, una all dey share grace with me.
For God na my witness, how I dey long for una all with di tender love of Christ Jesus.
This na wetin I dey pray, say una love go abound more and more for knowledge and all good judgment;
so that una go approve di things wey dey excellent; so that una go dey sincere and without offense until di day of Christ;
and dey full of di fruits of righteousness wey dey come through Jesus Christ, to di glory and praise of God.
Now I want make una know, brothers, say di things wey happen to me don turn out rather to help di Good News go forward;
so that e don clear to di whole palace guard, and to all di rest, say my chains na for Christ;
and say most of di brothers for di Lord, wey my chains don give courage, dey speak di word of God with more boldness without fear.
Some dey preach Christ even because of envy and quarrel, and some dey do am because of good will.
Di first group dey preach Christ from selfish ambition, no with sincere heart, and dem think say dem dey add trouble to my chains;
but di second group dey do am from love, because dem know say dem put me here to defend di Good News.
Wetin matter? Only say in every way, whether na pretense or na truth, dem dey preach Christ. I dey rejoice for this, yes, and I go rejoice.
For I know say this go turn out to my salvation through una prayer and di supply of di Spirit of Jesus Christ,
according to my strong expectation and hope, say I no go dey disappointed for anything, but with all boldness, as always, now also dem go lift Christ high for my body, whether by life or by death.
For me, to live na Christ, and to die na gain.
But if I continue to dey live for body, this na di fruit of my work; yet wetin I go choose, I no know.
But two things dey press me: I dey desire to leave go dey with Christ, wey dey far better;
yet to remain for body dey more necessary for una sake.
As I dey sure of this, I know say I go remain, yes, and remain with una all, for una progress and joy for di faith,
so that una boasting for Christ Jesus go abound because of me, through my presence with una again.

Only live in way wey worthy of di Good News of Christ, so that whether I come see una or I no dey, I go hear about una condition, say una dey stand firm for one spirit, with one soul dey struggle together for di faith of di Good News;
and make nothing frighten una because of una enemies. This na proof of destruction for dem, but of salvation for una, and e come from God.
Because God don grant una, for Christ sake, no only to believe for am, but also to suffer for im sake,
as una dey face di same struggle wey una see for me, and wey una still dey hear say e dey for me now.
So if any encouragement dey for Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of di Spirit, if any tender mercy and compassion,
make my joy full, by having di same mind, di same love, dey agree together, dey of one mind;
no do anything from rivalry or pride, but with humility, each person dey count others better pass imself;
make each of una no dey look only im own things, but each of una go look di things of others too.
Make this mind dey una, wey dey for Christ Jesus too,
wey dey for di form of God, no consider say to be equal with God na something to hold tight,
but e empty imself, take di form of servant, dem make am like men.
And as dem find am for human form, e humble imself, obey until death, yes, di death of di cross.
So God also lift am up very high, and give am di name wey dey above every name;
so that for di name of Jesus every knee go bow, of those for heaven, those for earth, and those under di earth,
and every tongue go confess say Jesus Christ na Lord, to di glory of Papa God.
So then, my beloved, as una don always obey, no only when I dey with una, but now much more when I no dey, work out una own salvation with fear and trembling.
For na God dey work for una, both to want and to work, for im good pleasure.
Do all things without complaining and quarrel,
so that una go dey blameless and harmless, God pikin dem without fault for middle of crooked and wicked generation, wey una dey shine among dem like lights for di world,
as una dey hold di word of life; so that I go get something to boast for di day of Christ, say I no run for nothing and I no labor for nothing.
Yes, and if dem pour me out on top di sacrifice and service of una faith, I dey rejoice, and I dey rejoice with una all.
Una too, una rejoice in di same way, and rejoice with me.
But I hope for di Lord Jesus to send Timothy to una soon, so that I too go get encouragement when I know una condition.
For I no get anybody else wey get di same mind, wey go truly care about una.
For dem all dey look for dem own, no be di things of Jesus Christ.
But una know im proof, say as pikin dey serve im papa, na so e serve with me for di work of di Good News.
So I hope to send am quick as I see how things go be with me.
But I trust for di Lord say I myself go come soon too.
But I think say e necessary to send Epaphroditus come meet una, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and una apostle and di one wey serve my need;
because e dey long for una all, and e dey very troubled because una don hear say e sick.
For true, e sick reach near death, but God show am mercy; and no only am, but me too, so that sorrow no go join sorrow for me.
So I don send am with more hurry, so that when una see am again, una go rejoice, and my sorrow go reduce.
So receive am for di Lord with all joy, and honor people like am,
because for di work of Christ e come near death, e risk im life to supply wetin dey lack for una service to me.
Finally, my brothers, rejoice for di Lord. To write di same things to una no tire me, but e dey safe for una.
Beware of di dogs, beware of di evil workers, beware of di false circumcision.
For we na di circumcision, we wey dey worship by God Spirit, and dey rejoice for Christ Jesus, and no get confidence for di flesh;
though I myself fit get confidence even for di flesh. If any other man think say e get confidence for di flesh, I get more:
dem circumcise me for di eighth day, I dey from di nation of Israel, from di tribe of Benjamin, Hebrew of Hebrews; as for di law, Pharisee;
as for zeal, I dey persecute di church; as for di righteousness wey dey for di law, dem find me blameless.
But di things wey be gain to me, these ones I don count as loss for Christ.

Yes, certainly, I count all things as loss because di knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord pass everything; for am I don suffer di loss of all things, and I count dem as rubbish, so that I go gain Christ
and dem go find me for am, no with my own righteousness wey come from di law, but di one wey dey through faith for Christ, di righteousness wey come from God by faith;
so that I go know am, and di power of im resurrection, and di fellowship of im sufferings, as I dey become like im death;
if by any way I fit reach di resurrection from di dead.
No be say I don get am already, or say I don already perfect; but I dey press on, so that I go take hold of that thing wey Christ Jesus take me for.
Brothers, I no count myself say I don take hold yet, but one thing I dey do: I dey forget di things wey dey behind, and dey stretch go di things wey dey front,
I dey press on go di goal for di prize of God high calling for Christ Jesus.
So make all of us wey don mature think this way. If una think different for anything, God go show una that one too.
Still, make we waka by di same rule for wetin we don reach. Make we dey of di same mind.
Brothers, join together copy me, and look those wey dey waka this way, as una get us as example.
For many dey waka, wey I don tell una often, and now I dey tell una even as I dey cry, say dem na enemies of di cross of Christ,
dem end na destruction, dem god na dem belly, and dem glory dey for dem shame, and dem dey think about earthly things.
For our citizenship dey heaven, from where we dey wait for Savior, di Lord Jesus Christ;
wey go change di body of our humiliation so that e go be like di body of im glory, according to di power wey e fit use even subdue all things to imself.
So my brothers, wey I love and dey long for, my joy and crown, stand firm for di Lord like this, my beloved.
I beg Euodia, and I beg Syntyche, make dem think di same way for di Lord.
Yes, I beg you too, true partner, help these women, because dem labor with me for di Good News, together with Clement too, and di rest of my fellow workers, wey dem names dey for di book of life.
Rejoice for di Lord always! Again I go talk say, “Rejoice!”
Make all people know una gentleness. Di Lord dey near.
No dey worry about anything, but for everything, by prayer and request with thanksgiving, make una requests known to God.
And di peace of God, wey pass all understanding, go guard una hearts and una thoughts for Christ Jesus.

Finally, brothers, whatever dey true, whatever dey honorable, whatever dey just, whatever dey pure, whatever dey lovely, whatever get good report; if any virtue dey, and if anything dey wey worth praise, think about these things.
Di things wey una learn, receive, hear, and see for me, do these things, and di God of peace go dey with una.
But I rejoice for di Lord greatly, say now at last una don revive una thought for me; una dey think about me before, but una no get chance.
No be say I dey talk because of lack, for I don learn say for whatever condition I dey, make I dey content for am.
I know how to dey low, and I know how to abound too. For everything and for all things I don learn di secret, both to dey full and to dey hungry, both to abound and to dey need.
I fit do all things through Christ wey dey strengthen me.
Still, una do well say una share for my affliction.
Una too know, Philippians, say for di beginning of di Good News, when I leave Macedonia, no church share with me for di matter of giving and receiving, except una only.
For even for Thessalonica una send once and again to my need.
No be say I dey look for di gift, but I dey look for di fruit wey dey increase for una account.
But I get all things, and I abound. I full, as I don receive from Epaphroditus di things wey come from una, sweet-smelling fragrance, sacrifice wey dem accept, wey please God well.
My God go supply every need of una according to im riches for glory for Christ Jesus.
Now to our God and Papa make glory dey forever and ever. Amen.
Greet every saint for Christ Jesus. Di brothers wey dey with me greet una.
All di saints greet una, especially those wey dey Caesar house.
Make di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una spirit. Amen.
